description.value:
Trigger A creature hits you with a melee Strike that would deal physical damage.

Frequency once per day

You flicker into hydrified form for an instant. Reduce the triggering Strike's damage by 1d6 + half your level (minimum 1). If this would reduce the damage to 0, you take no damage but become flat-footed against the triggering creature until the end of its next turn while you re-solidify.
